testo:
Speed Attacker
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature, choose one of your opponent's creatures that has power 6000 or less and destroy it.
■ Dragon Mana Arms 5: When this creature is destroyed, if you have 5 or more dragon creatures in your mana zone and this isn't an extra turn, you may put a total of 5 Jack-Pot cards from your mana zone or graveyard on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, take an extra turn after this one.
